labels.text: Review a hosted pull request by number, URL or branch, read with the GitHub CLI.
Post the review to the pull request as a comment.

S56.32.needs: a GitHub pull request you can comment on, and the GitHub CLI (gh) signed in
S56.32.note: Reading and posting use the GitHub CLI (gh pr diff and gh pr review --comment); --post works only with --pr.
steps: Sign in to the GitHub CLI (gh) with an account that can see a test pull request.
In a terminal run agi review --pr <number> and read the review printed.
Run agi review --pr <number> --post on the same test pull request.
Open the pull request on GitHub.
Compare the new review comment on GitHub with the printed review.
